verdict.rationale: Oyster can be driven headlessly through its own public API rather than the web UI. Client-credentials authorization supports non-interactive, machine-to-machine integrations for internal use. API workflows such as creating and submitting EOR employments can be scripted, and developer sandboxes with seed data allow automated testing against non-production data. However, there is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and no hands-on evidence of pipeline use, so headless operation is only implied through API integration. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
